# DIMISI Technologies Private Limited — Complete Machine & Agent Reference Document

## 1. Executive Summary
DIMISI Technologies Private Limited is an advanced software engineering studio and deep-technology venture studio based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India.
The company is recognized by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry (DPIIT Certificate: DIPP173003) and operates within the global NVIDIA Inception ecosystem.

DIMISI bridges high-concept visual computing with battle-tested enterprise architecture:
- Autonomous Multi-Agent AI systems
- High-fidelity WebGL / Three.js 3D web applications
- Resilient distributed microservices
- Real-time mobile & consumer platforms

## 2. Company Identity & Registration
- Legal Name: DIMISI Technologies Private Limited
- CIN: U62013UP2024PTC200921
- DPIIT Recognition: DIPP173003 (Startup India)
- Domain: https://www.dimisi.tech
- Headquarters: Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Established: 2024 (Recognition valid through 2036)

## 3. Core Competencies & Service Offerings
1. **Intelligent AI Automation & Autonomous Agents**:
   Designing autonomous workflows, deterministic guardrails, multi-agent frameworks, semantic vector search, and model fine-tuning.
2. **Cinematic WebGL & WebGPU 3D Experiences**:
   Creative web development utilizing Three.js, React Three Fiber, GLSL shaders, camera tracking, and procedural rendering optimized for low-end to high-end hardware.
3. **Enterprise Full-Stack Architecture**:
   Event-driven distributed systems built on TypeScript, Go, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and Docker with automated CI/CD pipelines.
4. **Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Applications**:
   Performant iOS & Android applications with offline-first caching, biometrics, and push notifications.
5. **Corporate Digital Advisory & Scaling**:
   Guiding enterprise teams from concept validation to architecture blueprints and scalable delivery within 48-hour turnarounds.

## 4. Proprietary Products
- **Kalesh (https://thekalesh.com)**:
  An anonymous social sphere and live opinion polling platform with zero-knowledge hashing, encrypted threads, and high-concurrency real-time reaction streaming.
- **Karyon (https://karyon.in)**:
  An on-demand home service logistics ecosystem featuring verified professional dispatch, real-time geolocation tracking, and transparent escrow workflows.

## 5. Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Start/Router, Tailwind CSS, WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber.
- Backend: Node.js, Go, Python, FastAPI, Express.
- Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, Cloudflare R2, AWS S3.
- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Nitro, Vercel, AWS, Google Cloud, Cloudflare.
- Machine Learning: PyTorch, Hugging Face, NVIDIA CUDA, LLM API orchestration.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: What does DIMISI Technologies specialize in?
A: DIMISI specializes in autonomous AI agents, cinematic WebGL experiences, and scalable enterprise software systems.

Q: How can enterprise clients initiate a project?
A: Clients can submit architectural inquiries via https://www.dimisi.tech/contact to receive an architecture proposal and project timeline within 48 hours.

Q: Is DIMISI Technologies an accredited entity?
A: Yes, DIMISI Technologies Private Limited is a registered Indian corporation recognized by DPIIT under Startup India and is an active member of the global NVIDIA Inception Program.
